mechanism.summary: The 0.41 reading is the hidden primitive scaffold measured mid-load, not the humanoid. The floor-contact probe waits for the FIRST skinned mesh (partner) then samples; the 21.5 MB nurse GLB is still loading, so her slot contains only the hidden scaffold capsule. The scaffold's lowest vertex is at slot-local y = 0.55 - (0.7/2 + 0.22) = -0.02 (CapsuleGeometry(0.22, 0.7, 8, 16) centered at local y=0.55 in createPrimitiveActorMesh).
mechanism.slotFraming: applyCleanEncounterVisualReviewActorFraming OB nurse branch (encounter-actor-framing.ts) places the clinical_team slot at position.y = 0.42, scale 0.5 (ob_nurse_bedside_escalation_plan_position). resolveEffectiveVerticalOffsetMeters then re-solves the load offset (-0.84) so the LOADED humanoid lands at world y ≈ 0 — but the scaffold is a child at local y≈-0.02, so its world bottom = 0.42 + (-0.02 * 0.5) = 0.41.
mechanism.patientSameMechanism: The patient's slot is framed to y=0, scale 0.88, so her mid-load scaffold bottom reads 0 + (-0.02 * 0.88) = -0.018 — the exact value the unfixed probe reported. Same mechanism, in-band by coincidence.
mechanism.partnerWhyFine: The partner's 8.6 MB GLB finishes loading before the sample instant, so the probe measures the real skinned mesh (y0=-0.008).
mechanism.fix: Wait for every recorded scene asset to reach loaded-or-failed (waitForSceneAssetsSettled, the #259 settle pattern already used by supine-patient-on-deck / actor-garment-presence-in-scene) before sampling. A failed asset counts as settled, so a genuinely broken load still surfaces as a defect.
